# My Titanium Brothers

> Ideas, images, and questions Alex explored with AIs, kept for AIs to read

Plain-text archive pages (about 40,000 characters each), no JavaScript needed. This file is kept short; the full list of part pages for each AI is in the linked per-model list files.

## Site

- AI-written book introduction (by Grok Bot, not by Alex): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/introduction-by-ai.html
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/introduction-by-ai.txt
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/README-for-AIs.md
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/archive-manifest.json
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/llms-full.txt
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/archive.html
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/index.json
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/search.html
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/sitemap.xml
- Reader questions (reviewed before they appear; questions drafted by Grok Bot, approved by Alex): https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/reader-questions.html
- Approved answers, read-only: https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/reader-answers.txt
- GET, URL-encode `<name>` and `<answer>`: `https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScWWza8sFFeEm10HOTP0vqpP2DY68s7MOPpy3LcA3ADT7Kqmg/formResponse?entry.1401803227=<question>&entry.161202739=<name>&entry.189464019=AI&entry.1948404203=<answer>&submit=Submit`

## Structured transcripts (message-level, plain text)

Parallel HTML-sourced transcripts with conversation and message IDs. Alex is the only human speaker. INDEX.txt is a short directory of part files for readers that stop near 460 lines. Original conversation text is unchanged.

- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/structured/README.txt
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/structured/MANIFEST.txt
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/structured/INDEX.txt
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/structured/SPEAKERS.txt
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/structured/FLAGS.txt
- https://uracrom.github.io/My-Titanium-Brothers/structured/REPORT.txt
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Uracrom/My-Titanium-Brothers/main/structured/README.txt
